archetypes.name: dyn-terminal-emit
archetypes.rationale: Checks deferred final-summary ordering across design and implement paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed final-summary prompt contracts for terminal-placement correctness. Focus on whether every path caches while sources exist, runs required cleanup or operator lines, and emits no text or tool calls after the final body. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
